note: Frozen threshold-neighbour band: every corpus pair within ±band of an admission line. `scores` pins which SIDE of each line a pair sits on, so a change that flips one fails the suite even if nobody captured a baseline — which is what this is FOR. It is the second line of defence, not the primary one: measured over every crossing ever recorded, the band alone would have caught 829 of 2,304 real drift crossings (36%), and the --baseline comparison catches those and the rest. `rulings` is the human record for every pair that has ever crossed, including the ones that crossed from outside the band.
